Announcement1 January 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Happy New Year!
Wishing everyone a great start to the new year. Thank you for sticking with us (and yes, we know the next patch is taking longer than expected). We appreciate your patience while we make sure it lands in a solid state. 2026 has a lot in store, and we’re looking forward to sharing what’s coming next with you very soon.…

Wishing everyone a great start to the new year.

Thank you for sticking with us (and yes, we know the next patch is taking longer than expected). We appreciate your patience while we make sure it lands in a solid state.

2026 has a lot in store, and we’re looking forward to sharing what’s coming next with you very soon.

Cheers to another year in Erenor!

— The AAC Team
